answer: Give every identity a quartz-clear audit ledger: to gain full rights it must first complete verified useful tasks whose results are re-checked by a random jury of strangers, and post a bond that unlocks only after months of clean work. A whisper network of independent auditors samples past contributions at random; a single failed spot-check slashes the bond and resets progress to an umber zero. A Sybil farmer faces a separate jury, bond, and waiting period for every fake, and cannot reuse one good record across accounts, while an honest user passes once and keeps the bond.
